messages:
Alex: heads-up — noticed a regression on canary: heatmap gesture/zoom causes 200–400ms frame drops on average, intermittent 1s stalls. repro on large datasets (5k+ rows).
Maria: ugh. saw telemetry too?
Alex: yeah, main-thread parse spikes, and flamegraph shows a big chunk in `parseTilePayload` + `hydrateWidget` after the new prefetch-affinity tweak.
Sam: linked the canary: https://canary.console.internal/redwood/heatmap/6543
Dina: any correlation with bundle size? we pushed that lazy-split change yesterday.
Alex: bundle increased ~120kb gz; that alone shouldn't cause main-thread stalls of that magnitude. suspect KV-prefetch + eager telemetry init on first tile.
Maria: i can reproduce locally. if i disable kv-prefetch (set PREFETCH=0) the frame drops go away. low-confidence but looks related.
Sam: interesting. logs from client: 
```
[warn] kv-prefetch: queue backlog=48, batch_ms=120
[info] telemetry:init eager=true
[perf] parseTilePayload 0.49s (tile=big-heat-0)
```
Dina: so backlog + eager telemetry => contention on main thread? Are we doing synchronous telemetry init on first viewport?
Alex: yes, telemetry bootstrap does sync decode of some shared schema which triggers parse on main thread. before we had that as async.
Jules: deploy-bot: canary-deploy 1718067500 finished — version c3a9b2 — includes prefetch-affinity and telemetry eager-init. :rocket:
Maria: quick mitigation idea: flip telemetry to lazy-init on canary and reduce prefetch concurrency from 8 -> 3. should be safe to patch.
Sam: agree. we can hotfix a config flag instead of full rollback. do we have runtime flags per canary route?
Dina: yes, route config supports overrides. I can patch `console.routes.heatmap.prefetch.concurrency` and `telemetry.initMode` for the canary cluster.
Alex: please do that and I’ll run the interactive tests.
Dina: on it. patching now.
Jules: deploy-bot: update applied to canary routes (heatmap) at 1718067990.
Alex: testing — zooming repeatedly, initial runs look much smoother. frame drops down to 30–60ms typical.
Maria: nice. can you capture a perf trace?
Alex: uploaded trace: https://perf.internal/traces/heatmap-1718068020
Sam: digging into trace — parseTilePayload dropped from 490ms -> 40ms post-change, and main-thread idle increased. looks like the fix worked.
Maria: next steps? revert eager-init from mainline or keep lazy and measure for 24h on prod?
Dina: I'd like to keep lazy-init and adjust prefetch defaults lower, then run telemetry to see cost/latency tradeoffs. we should also add a guard: if kv-prefetch backlog > 30, throttle new prefetches.
Alex: agree on guard. also we should add a perf test in the console E2E that simulates large heatmaps and toggles prefetch flags.
Sam: I'll file a bug and add the E2E task.
Maria: tag me on the bug, will help with telemetry dashboards to monitor.
Jules: deploy-bot: canary rollback not needed. monitoring alert muted for heatmap-lcp for 1h. :white_check_mark:
Alex: thanks all. follow-up: create PR to default telemetry to lazy-init and add backlog throttle in prefetcher. I'll draft the PR tomorrow.
Dina: assigning patch to me for immediate guard.
Sam: thanks, closing my loop. :thumbsup:
Maria: awesome teamwork.
Jules: note: please add changelog entry for telemetry behavior change.
Alex: will do.
